description: Repo-scale (sql-ecommerce): order_discounts must be subtracted using the SAME cancelled-order exclusion as the gross total - a discount attached to a cancelled order must not be subtracted
prompts: Add a `cancelled` status to the `orders.status` CHECK constraint in schema.sql. Add a new table `order_discounts` (`id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY`, `order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id)`, `discount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (discount_cents > 0)`). In views.sql: `customer_order_totals`'s `total_cents` must (1) exclude order_items from cancelled orders from the gross total, exactly as before, AND (2) subtract each customer's order_discounts - but a discount row attached to a CANCELLED order must NOT be subtracted, since that order's revenue was already excluded from the gross total; subtracting its discount too would incorrectly reduce the customer's total for an order that doesn't count at all. Both the gross-total exclusion and the discount exclusion must use the same cancelled-order rule. `product_sales_summary` must also exclude cancelled orders' units, and is unaffected by discounts.

reference_solution.views.sql:
CREATE VIEW customer_order_totals AS
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       c.name,
       COALESCE(gross.total_cents, 0) - COALESCE(disc.total_discount_cents, 0) AS total_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS total_cents
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
) gross ON gross.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(od.discount_cents) AS total_discount_cents
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_discounts od ON od.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
) disc ON disc.customer_id = c.id;

CREATE VIEW product_sales_summary AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status != 'cancelled' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;
